name: Yaak
description: Yaak's release configuration supplies the Tauri updater with an HTTPS update endpoint and a minisign public key; the application updater checks, retrieves, and installs through the Tauri updater path. The reviewed updater module contains no API-client danger_accept_invalid_certs setting, and signature enforcement is delegated to the Tauri updater dependency.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; cryptographic enforcement is implemented by the Tauri updater dependency and was not independently audited.
